summary: Xcel Energy Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) common stock offering of up to $4.3 billion under an equity distribution agreement. The filing describes forward sale agreements with forward purchasers and sellers, allowing cash or share settlement. No price, premium, or board recommendation is provided. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital for general corporate purposes, not a special situation.
